title: Cognis Gap Detection Rules
description: Versioned configuration of rule-based, on-device gap-detection heuristics (Engineering Contracts: Yogesh owns Gap Detection; Full Software Spec gap taxonomy). Loaded at runtime; every threshold/marker/weight lives here so the engine carries no hardcoded numbers or text. Detected confidences are model estimates, not measurements.

note.description: Optional human note about provenance / disclosure.

minTextLength.description: Minimum prompt length (characters) before text rules run. Avoids flagging tiny fragments.

emitThreshold.description: Minimum confidence a gap signal must reach to be emitted.

maxSignals.description: Maximum number of gap signals emitted per analysis pass.

cognitivePauseMs.description: Pause duration (ms) that marks a cognitive (thinking) pause — the ghost-text trigger window. Shared with the Ghost Text engine.

stateModifiers.description: Additive confidence adjustment keyed by cognitive StateLabel. Overload raises gap likelihood; coasting lowers it.

revisionModifier.description: Additive confidence based on how many times the user has revised the prompt (a proxy for uncertainty).

rules.description: One rule per gap type in the Cognis gap taxonomy.

gapType.description: Gap taxonomy member (must match the GapType union).

baseConfidence.description: Confidence assigned when the gap is present (no satisfying marker found), before modifiers.

satisfiedWhenAnyPresent.description: Lexical markers; if ANY appears in the prompt (case-insensitive), the gap is considered addressed and is NOT emitted.
